summary: Business Administration student at Loyola Marymount University studying Information Systems and Business Analytics (May 2027, 3.8 GPA). Experience in event operations and production coordination, with skills in SQL, Python, Excel, and trend analysis.
seeking: Seeking full-time Data Analyst and Business Analyst roles starting after graduation in May 2027.
about:
I'm a Business Administration student at Loyola Marymount University studying Information Systems and Business Analytics, graduating in May 2027. I'm looking for a full-time data analyst or business analyst role where analysis shapes how a team plans and operates.

Alongside school, I've seen how operations work up close. At West EFX I analyzed budget documentation for U.S. government contracts and coordinated scheduling across teams and inventory. At Collins Visual Media & Step and Repeat LA I directed red carpet and backdrop installation for Hollywood promotional events and kept live operations running. Both taught me that numbers matter most when they help someone make a better call on the ground.

I also build with AI. This site is a class project in AI and cloud computing: I built it with AI coding agents, using plugins like Superpowers to work from a written spec and plan, test changes first, and keep the code organized, then deployed it to an Azure virtual machine over HTTPS. I want to use AI where it makes work faster and more reliable for the people who depend on it.
